descriptionFull: The ferruginous hawk ( ferruginous = from Latin ferrum – iron, ferrugin- , iron rust, iron-rust color – reddish-brown), Buteo regalis (Latin, royal hawk), is a large bird of prey and belongs to the broad-winged buteo hawks. An old colloquial name is ferrugineous rough-leg , due to its similarity to the closely related rough-legged hawk ( B. lagopus ).
